disposition_reason: Reports copper, lead, zinc and iron by flame AAS in 13 artisanal distilled spirits from Mozambique; cadmium and chromium not detected.

study.origin: produced in Manhiça, Xinavane, Chókwe, Massinga, Mafambisse, Beira and Chimoio districts, Mozambique, from sugarcane, cashew, nuts or cereal
study.method: flame AAS (Varian SpectrAA 110) after MAPA method no. 11 preparation
study.qa: triplicate determinations; no CRM or recovery reported

unresolved: Lead, zinc and iron unit conflict: Table 3 header says µg/L, text says mg/L (lead 0.6 to 3.66 mg/L, all above the 0.2 mg/L limit; iron 0.04 mg/L). Values kept as printed with integrity flags.

Lead is read at 217.0 nm with calibration from 0.05 mg/L; µg/L-level lead (0.6-3.7 µg/L) would be below that calibration range, which argues against the table header, but this is not resolved in the paper.
No detection limits reported; cadmium and chromium wavelengths not given.
